description: Accepted runtime sizes (bytes) of every contract and linked library under src/. CI (script/size_budget.py) fails when a runtime grows more than growth_limit bytes over its accepted size until the record is updated with a note. vault_rows lists the module rows of the vault size table that the current build implements (some only in part), with their budgets; the check reports the measured vault against their sum plus the unattributed allowance. The hard gate (every runtime <= 22,000 B plus an anvil deploy) is script/size_gate.py.
